title: Broadcom Inc. (AVGO) Laps the Stock Market: Here's Why
snippet:
Investors will be eagerly watching for the performance of Broadcom Inc. in its upcoming earnings disclosure. The company's earnings report is set to be unveiled on September 2, 2026. The company is forecasted to report an EPS of $3.22, showcasing a 90.53% upward movement from the corresponding quarter of the prior year. Alongside, our most recent consensus estimate is anticipating revenue of $29.47 billion, indicating a 84.74% upward movement from the same quarter last year. [...] For the annual period, the Zacks Consensus Estimates anticipate earnings of $11.74 per share and a revenue of $106.07 billion, signifying shifts of +72.14% and +66.03%, respectively, from the last year. [...] Looking at valuation, Broadcom Inc. is presently trading at a Forward P/E ratio of 31.02. This denotes a discount relative to the industry average Forward P/E of 36.93.

We can also see that AVGO currently has a PEG ratio of 0.61. The PEG ratio is similar to the widely-used P/E ratio, but this metric also takes the company's expected earnings growth rate into account. As of the close of trade yesterday, the Electronics - Semiconductors industry held an average PEG ratio of 1.06.
